Olivia Park: quick one 4A1 Were iterating on the multi-pane settings form. Options: inline-only errors, or inline + small sticky error tray after submit that lists issues and lets users jump. Also flagging required-marker visibility on collapsed panels. Thoughts? Daniel Cho: inline + a compact tray. Inline is contextual but hidden when panels collapse. Tray should be minimal: count + first 5 errors, each as a button. Maya Santos: +1. Tray should be dismissible and keyboard-accessible. Clicking an item should expand the panel and focus the field. Add a short sr-only header like "Form issues" so screen readers get context. Keita Yamamoto: a11y: use aria-live="assertive" for the tray on submit, but avoid double reading if input also gets aria-describedby. Strategy: announce tray, then set focus only when user activates the item. Olivia Park: proposal sketch: - Inline one-line messages under fields - On failed submit: show sticky tray with heading "3 issues found" and list of error buttons - Buttons expand panel + focus field; field gets aria-invalid and aria-describedby to the error text - For collapsed headers show a small badge like "1 error" Daniel Cho: edge case: very large forms (100+ errors). Cap tray list to 8 items and append "and N more". Don't flood screen readers. Maya Santos: required-marker: don't use color alone. Use visible asterisk plus sr-only "required" text. For compactness on headers, show a badge "2 required" that toggles to "2 errors" after validation. Keita Yamamoto: typed-confirmation for destructive bulk ops: recommendation: permanent irreversible = typed token (DELETE), reversible = checkbox. Consider threshold: any action >150 items -> require typed token. Copy: "This will permanently delete 12 workspaces. Type DELETE to confirm." Olivia Park: small code snippet for the tray interaction: ```html

Form issues

3 issues found. Use the list to jump to each field.

``` Daniel Cho: implementation notes: when button clicked -> expand parent, wait for expand animation (~200ms), then focus input and call scrollIntoView({block:'center'}). Also set aria-describedby = error-id. Maya Santos: accessibility-bot flagged missing accessible name on our modal in the branch. Will add tests for tray announcements on VoiceOver and TalkBack. accessibility-bot: scan results: 4 warnings on feature/settings-ux (modal missing accessible name; 2 fields missing aria-describedby; error tray lacks keyboard-visible dismiss). CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/7777 Olivia Park: action items: - Daniel: prototype tray + jump behavior (Codesandbox + brief demo) 4BB due Tue - Maya: draft copy guidelines for required markers + confirmation modals due Thu - Keita: a11y test cases matrix for tray & typed confirmations due Fri Daniel Cho: starting prototype now. Will keep tray minimal and behind feature flag. Maya Santos: I'll post copy examples in #copy-review later today. Keita Yamamoto: will run automated a11y checks and schedule a quick manual pass on devices. Olivia Park: thanks team 64C closing thread and will share prototype link when ready.
